data.name: Accend
data.description: Accend advises companies with carbon-negative products on the CORC markets and offers a full-service process including pre-qualification, registration, life cycle analysis, account management, certificate marketing, sales and settlement. They work with leading standards, including as a Puro.earth-accredited partner and C-sink trader, to bring projects to certification and market. They do not operate pyrolysis plants themselves but support biochar and timber producers across Europe and North America.
